items.title: Doomscrolling (and kids) destroyed my reading habit. Could the ‘Booker Challenge’ save it?
items.brief: Each January, for the last few years, I have set myself a (what I thought to be) perfectly achievable New Year’s resolution: to read, for the sake of pleasure alone, 12 books in 12 months.

items.title: Officer killed, 3 wounded in a gunfight with suspect in Colorado
items.brief: An officer was killed and three others were wounded during a firefight in a Denver suburb Thursday evening with a man who was fatally shot by police, according to law enforcement.

items.title: Fresh bomb threats hit European flights — and mystery remains who is behind them
